identityScope: Four existing catalog rows in the cleaning category that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Dreame product pages. Aqua10 Ultra Roller Complete, Matrix10 Pro, W10 Pro and X60 Ultra are separate catalog rows; the Complete row is the bundle variant of the already reviewed Aqua10 Ultra Roller and shares its product page. No new model was created and no Dreame company focus review exists. The Aqua10 Ultra Roller Complete page publishes 30,000 Pa, a continuously rinsed FluffRoll roller, AutoSeal, ProLeap, OmniSight 2.0 for 240+ objects, 6,400 mAh, a 220 ml dust box, 100/140 ml water boxes, 4 L/3.5 L station tanks, 100 C washing, about four hours of drying, a 3.2 L bag for 100 days, a 350 x 350 x 97.5 mm body at 5.8 kg, a 16.54 x 17.32 x 19.88 in base station at 11.1 kg and 899.99 USD against 1,599.99 USD. The Matrix10 Pro page publishes 30,000 Pa, a three-mop switching dock, a three-solution compartment, Dual Flex Arm, a HyperStream DuoBrush, 100 C ThermoHub washing, 10.5 mm mop lifting, 40/22 mm obstacle crossing, 280+ objects, 4.1 kg, a 350 x 350 x 104 mm body, a 416 x 457 x 590 mm station at 16.1 kg, 6,400 mAh, a 250 ml dust box, a 3.2 L bag, 5.5/4.0 L tanks, 100 days of auto-empty and 1,499.99 USD against 1,624.99 USD. The W10 Pro page publishes 4,000 Pa, 180 RPM, a 19.2 cm roller, a 334 x 314 x 105.5 mm body, a 450 ml dust box, a 375 x 400 x 430 mm station with 4.5/4.0 L tanks, 6,400 mAh, 160 minutes over 200 m2 and three floor plans, but no price or robot mass. The X60 Ultra page publishes 35,000 Pa, a 79.5 mm retractable sensor, 40 C mopping at 230 RPM and 15 N, 100 C mop washing, 8.8/4.5 cm obstacle crossing, 280+ objects, 4.7 kg, a 350 x 350 x 79.5 mm body, a 390 x 423 x 499 mm station at 10.6 kg, a 235 ml dust box, a 3.2 L bag, 4.2/3.0 L tanks, 100 days of auto-empty, 80 minutes from 9 to 80 percent and 1,349.99 USD against 1,499.99 USD. None of the reviewed pages publishes a full-charge runtime for the Complete, Matrix10 Pro or X60 Ultra; only the X60 Ultra publishes a charging time; none publishes an IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or minimum aisle width.

companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch164. Dreame pages read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. X50 Ultra, L40 Ultra, Matrix10 Ultra and Aqua10 Ultra Roller are four separate current models. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions. All USPs, complete portfolios and leadership remain unproven.
highlights: Dreame is a consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer whose current US range includes the X50 Ultra, L40 Ultra, Matrix10 Ultra and Aqua10 Ultra Roller.

Its robot vacuum lines use different mop systems: multi-mop switching on the Matrix10 Ultra, a self-rinsing roller mop on the Aqua10 Ultra Roller, MopExtend RoboSwing on the L40 Ultra and a retractable VersaLift sensor on the X50 Ultra.
The reviewed pages publish 11,000 Pa suction for the L40 Ultra, 20,000 Pa for the X50 Ultra and 30,000 Pa for the Matrix10 Ultra and Aqua10 Ultra Roller.
Battery capacity is 5,200 mAh for the L40 Ultra and 6,400 mAh for the other three; the X50 Ultra page cites up to 220 min of cleaning and 205 m2 per charge, the L40 Ultra page up to 194 min.
The reviewed pages publish no dB noise rating, absolute charging time, payload or IP rating; prices are dated US sale observations against regular prices.
